data.long_meaning: Antoinetta is a Greek name derived from the Greek words 'antos' meaning 'grace' and 'eidos' meaning 'form' or 'appearance'. It was a common name in the Middle Ages and Renaissance, particularly in Italy, where it was associated with the Virgin Mary. It was believed to bring good fortune and protection. The name Antoinetta carries the meaning “Graceful, priceless” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Antoinetta usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, priceless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
